name: The Memory-Keeper's Room
story: Cut into the cliff, one window, and a wall of knotted cords: the Rope-Song, every verse of it. There is metre in the song for eight clans and only seven cords, and Dunna will show you the gap if you ask twice.
who_was_here: Every memory-keeper of Clan Kharrow, each of whom added a cord and none of whom added the eighth.
unique_object: a wall of knotted cords with a gap where the eighth verse should hang
